scope: C1-C3 missing callback, ref, keyboard, session and clipboard acceptance fixtures

focusedAutomation.proof: Server-rendered fixture structure, public enum rendering, exported adapters, compound-member identity, ref-bearing component kinds, exact selectors and initial observable outputs.
focusedAutomation.doesNotProve: Hydrated callbacks, DOM ref attachment, browser keyboard transitions, session reload, clipboard settlement, tooltip portals or focus appearance.

states: colors gray, blue, green, orange, yellow, red, purple, white, surface, white-destructive, surface-destructive
sizes xs, sm, md and lg
info, warning, note, tip, check, danger and custom variants
name, type, location, default, required, deprecated, pre and post metadata
boolean and legacy string initial state
uniqueParamId session state before and after reload
ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End keyboard selection
ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home, End, asterisk and typeahead keyboard behavior
titleSize p, h2, h3 and h4
open, closed, nested, empty and openable false
local, fragment, external and protocol-relative href
horizontal, CTA, arrow, image and empty content
graphical, empty, long title and description
active, inactive, switched, unmatched and empty registry
current string and legacy light/dark values
iconType brands, duotone, light, regular, sharp-duotone-solid, sharp-light, sharp-regular, sharp-solid, sharp-thin, solid and thin
color, colorLight, colorDark, size, overrideColor, overrideSize, basePath and local URL
table row with title and standalone ColorRow parity

setup: Navigate to /design-review/components#status-client-callbacks and wait for data-fixture-events=status-callbacks to contain ParamHead mounted: yes.
actions: Focus the button named Run Badge callback.
Press Tab to move to Run linked Badge callback, then Shift+Tab to return to the button.
Press Space on the button.
Focus Run linked Badge callback and press Enter.
assertions: The focused Badge is document.activeElement after each keyboard move.
Computed outlineWidth is 2px, outlineOffset is 3px and outlineColor is rgb(19, 118, 109) while focus-visible.
Output contains Button callbacks: 1 and Link callbacks: 1.
Output records the corresponding focused label.
The link activation sets location.hash to #c1-badge-linked-target.

setup: Click Enable ParamHead clipboard denial and wait for the output to contain Clipboard mode: denied.
actions: Click the field-name link clipboardDenied inside #c1-paramhead-clipboard-denial.
Wait for the output hash field to settle.
Click Restore clipboard and wait for Clipboard mode: native.
assertions: location.hash is #c1-paramhead-clipboard-denial.
Output contains Hash: #c1-paramhead-clipboard-denial.
Output contains Unhandled rejections: 0.
The control reads Enable ParamHead clipboard denial again after restoration.

setup: Wait for data-fixture-events=steps to contain registered:c2-step-callbacks.
actions: Click the anchor inside #c2-step-callbacks [data-component-part=step-number-anchor-link].
Click Unmount callback step.
Click Remount callback step while the fragment remains #c2-step-callbacks.
assertions: The real browser clipboard reads as the current page URL ending in #c2-step-callbacks.
location.hash is #c2-step-callbacks.
Output contains copied:c2-step-callbacks, unregistered:c2-step-callbacks, scrolled:c2-step-callbacks and registered:c2-step-callbacks.

setup: Focus the sole visible treeitem whose tabindex is 0 and assert only one visible treeitem has tabindex 0.
actions: Press ArrowRight on open src to focus commonMain.
Press ArrowRight on open commonMain to focus StoreBuilderWithAnIntentionallyLongFileName.kt.
Press End to focus package.json, then Home to focus src.
Press * on src to open the closed sibling folder.
Type p to focus package.json, then type c after the 500 ms typeahead reset to focus closed.
Press ArrowLeft on open closed to collapse it, ArrowRight to reopen it, ArrowDown and ArrowUp to move between adjacent visible items.
assertions: After every move exactly one visible treeitem has tabindex 0 and it is document.activeElement.
aria-expanded on closed changes false to true, then true to false, then false to true.
Output data-fixture-events=tree reports the focused label and the exact open-folder list after each keyup.
empty and unavailable never gain aria-expanded.

setup: Wait for data-fixture-events=tabs to contain Selected index: 1 | Panels ref: attached.
actions: Focus the selected second tab.
Press ArrowRight twice, End, Home, ArrowLeft and Space in sequence, waiting for focus after each navigation key.
assertions: ArrowRight moves 1 to 2 and wraps 2 to 0. End selects 2. Home selects 0. ArrowLeft wraps 0 to 2. Space keeps the focused tab selected.
After every transition exactly one tab has aria-selected=true and tabindex=0.
The selected tab is document.activeElement after ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End.
Output keeps Panels ref: attached and reports the selected index from onTabChange.
The panelsRef target has data-component-part=tabs-panels.

setup: Click Reset session fixture and reload, wait for navigation, then wait for the summary containing session fields to report aria-expanded=true from defaultOpen.
actions: Activate the session fields summary once to close it and wait for the output to contain Stored session state: false.
Click Reload session fixture and wait for navigation and hydration.
assertions: Before reload, output contains Stored session state: false.
After reload, the session fields summary reports aria-expanded=false and its details root is closed.
The response fields Expandable without uniqueParamId is unaffected by the stored session value.

setup: Wait for data-fixture-events=update to contain Ref: attached and registered:layout-update-callbacks.
actions: Click the update label September 2026.
Click Unmount callback update.
Click Remount callback update.
assertions: The real browser clipboard reads as the current page URL ending in #layout-update-callbacks and location.hash matches.
Output contains copied:layout-update-callbacks.
After unmount output contains Ref: detached and unregistered:layout-update-callbacks.
After remount output contains Ref: attached and the visible root id is layout-update-callbacks.

setup: Wait for data-fixture-events=view to contain Active ref: Kotlin.
actions: Click Show Swift, then click Show Kotlin.
assertions: After Show Swift only Swift active view mounted is present and output contains Active ref: Swift.
After Show Kotlin only Kotlin active view mounted is present and output contains Active ref: Kotlin.
Inactive Web and Empty registry content never appears.

setup: Use the browser's native clipboard for the interaction.
actions: Hover or focus the table swatch button named Ink.
Click the Ink swatch.
assertions: An open role=tooltip portal contains #172C2A and is linked to the Ink trigger.
The real browser clipboard reads exactly #172C2A.
The Ink button changes aria-pressed from false to true and aria-roledescription from Copy to Copied.
The button retains background-color rgb(23, 44, 42).
